purpose: Define the country/territory polygon as the primary spatial doorway into the World Relational Atlas rather than a decorative choropleth cell.
core_rule: A polygon is geometry plus identity routing. It is not the country record itself and it is never a moral score for an entire people.

interaction_states.idle: polygon rendered according to selected map layer
interaction_states.hover: temporary emphasis plus resolved country/territory code
interaction_states.selected: persistent high-contrast border; polygon becomes origin node for local graph
interaction_states.focused: map fits selected polygon geometry while preserving graph context
interaction_states.neighbor: land-border adjacent polygon highlighted separately from alliance/project relations
interaction_states.related: polygon connected by a curated typed relationship edge
interaction_states.unresolved: geometry exists but canonical country/territory owner is missing or ambiguous

event_grammar: click -> select polygon and load canonical dossier
show relations -> render curated typed cross-border edges
click relation edge -> inspect relationship record
follow relation -> change selected origin polygon
deep link -> preserve country + layer in URL

polygon_identity.fallback: resolved country/territory name against geographic metadata
polygon_identity.territory_rule: A territory polygon must not be silently promoted to sovereign-state status merely because the geometry exists. Territory/constitutional status requires its own relationship data.

edge_separation.curated_relation: typed project/observable relation from canonical world graph
edge_separation.interpretive: North/West/East/Swamp/Timic relation with explicit epistemic-plane label
edge_separation.rule: Never render all edges as if they mean the same thing. Visual styling and edge cards must preserve type and provenance.

zoom_behavior.polygon_role: regional graph origin; border and corridor relations become legible
country dossier container; major institutions/issues/relations can appear
country polygon becomes context shell while cities, ports, facilities and sites become primary nodes

implemented_2026_09_10: double-click fit to selected country geometry
